rule: Owner decision 2026-10-22: "All universities should include all faculty that work on CS-related topics / publish in CS venues (Even if not in CS)." A Princeton person qualifies when (1) a faculty member of any department in some year 2016-2026 (professor ranks, incl. emeriti; lecturers without PhD advising, research scholars, instructors, postdocs, students and visitors do not), (2) a PI: stated PhD advising 2016-2026 (a named adviser field of a DataSpace doctoral dissertation record, or advisees named on their department profile) or a lab they head alone; senior-thesis advising never makes a PI, and (3) CS-related: on hierarchy/princeton/cs-related-candidates.json, or at least 5 works 2016-2026 with a Princeton-affiliated authorship in a venue of hierarchy/cs-venues.json (chapters of one book count once). Appointment years are dated department faculty-list captures (one row per year and half); visiting-faculty entries and advance listings are not used. Faculty already in hierarchy/princeton/pis.json are not candidates.

candidates.universe: cs-related-candidates.json (24) + thesis-harvest non-PI advisers (98) = 121 names after merging
candidates.department_list_scan: non-CS Princeton faculty lists stored by claude-princeton-listings-20261022 (ECE, ORFE, Mathematics, MAE, Psychology, Sociology, SPIA, LSI, Music, Architecture) matched to the author index (>=5 CS-venue works, not in pis.json): 20 more names
candidates.author_index_scan: every other Princeton OpenAlex author with >=5 CS-venue works checked by hand (182, all students/postdocs/research staff except Daniel I. Rubenstein)

notes: tools/princeton_census.py does not read additions; tools/pi_hierarchy.py appends census/princeton-additions.json to census/princeton-faculty.json, and reads listings/princeton/listings.json for yearly listings.
Live princeton.edu department pages (ece., eeb.) answered with a bot challenge (stored with error=bot-challenge, not retried); department lists come from Wayback captures.
Flag cs_bar_met_via_noncomputing_venues: the person meets the 5-work bar only through venues of cs-venues.json that are not computing venues (Cell Systems, statistics or psychology journals).

supplement.rule: Owner decision 2026-10-22: "All universities should include all faculty that work on CS-related topics / publish in CS venues (Even if not in CS)." Candidates: hierarchy/<school>/cs-related-candidates.json (tools/cs_related_candidates.py: OpenAlex authors with 8+ school works 2016-2026, 5+ and 20%+ of them DBLP-indexed, last author on 30%+ or 30+ works, not already a PI). A candidate is accepted when (1) faculty at the school in some year 2016-2026 in any department (professor ranks incl. adjunct/titular and emeriti; EPFL MER/Senior Scientist heading a group; not postdocs, research staff, lecturers without PhD direction, visitors/host professors or students), (2) a PI: first-listed thesis director / named adviser of a 2016-2026 doctoral thesis record, or a lab they head alone, and (3) appointment years come from dated faculty lists (emeritus entries are not appointment years); a reviewed period is added to hierarchy/census-overrides.json when the appointment does not cover 2016-2026.
